feeds.title: Princess Pinky Girl
feeds.description: Hi! I am Jenn, mother to three beautiful boys, wife to an amazing husband, social influencer, and blogger. If you do not like cooking or think you cannot cook, you have come to the right place! Princess Pinky Girl is all about easy recipes and I promise you, ANYONE CAN MAKE them and no one will question your cooking ability ever again. Follow the blog and discover lots of secrets to quick & easy desserts.

feeds.title: This Worthey Life Blog
feeds.description: Tatanisha, mom of three teen boys is a food blogger with her husband Derrick Worthey at 'This Worthey Life'. This Worthey Life inspires everyone to live a 'worthy' life by sharing their passion through food, travel, entertainment, and life adventures, helping parents through the tween and teen years of parenting boys by empowering them with our personal stories and experiences.

feeds.title: Mommy Gone Healthy
feeds.description: I'm Amber, a 30 something-year-old wife and mama. I have two wonderful children, Aiden and Brielle, and an incredibly supportive and hardworking husband. I'm fueled by coffee, re-energized with yoga, loves a good mind-clearing run, gardening, creating recipes in the kitchen, and unwinding with a glass of wine.

feeds.title: The Nutritionist Reviews
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Amanda Hernandez, a registered dietitian with a Master's degree that lives in the Metro Detroit area. I'm a full-time blogger and mom and am truly living the dream. I enjoy blogging about food, parenting, fitness, nutrition, my love of travel, living in Michigan, and staying healthy and love working with brands, creating healthy, fresh, and easy recipes, trying new products, and sharing nutrition information. Subscribe to my blog to read more!

feeds.title: Oakland County Moms
feeds.description: Oakland County Moms is a community resource for families in Oakland County and SE Michigan. Follow to get the latest updates on local events, activities, contests, news, reviews, freebies & more.

feeds.title: Michigan Mama News
feeds.description: Michigan Mama News (and Dads too!) is an online blog magazine serving Michigan families and beyond in the areas of fun Michigan news, recipes, wellness, homeschool, travel, arts and crafts, reviews, giveaways, and more.

feeds.title: Metro Detroit Mommy
feeds.description: Welcome to Metro Detroit Mommy, I'm Amber Louchart, a mom and your local guide to finding places in and all-around Southeast Michigan to play and activities that are fun and safe for you and your children. Follow to keep up with the latest from this blog.

feeds.title: Slay At Home Mother
feeds.description: Hello! I am Corinne. I am a mother of two, a wife to an amazing and supportive man, and the founder, editor, and author of Slay At Home Mother. I started blogging because, well, I love to write! On my blog, you will find articles about home improvement, DIY projects, trying to conceive, motherhood, pregnancy, cleaning, organizing, and meal planning!

feeds.title: Mama of Many Blessings
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Nicole. I am a homeschool mama to 6 blessings and a Michigander. Here on my website, I share a bit of everything. You will find parenting, homeschool tips and ideas, travel, kids crafts, and more. I also started sharing our tested and family favorite recipes. This was for my kids to find their favorite recipes, and for others to enjoy as well. Subscribe the blog and never miss a post!

feeds.title: Mrs. Weber's Neighborhood
feeds.description: Welcome! Hi, I'm Lauren. I am an extrovert who loves researching and sharing information, so blogging is a natural fit for my personality. I write about life with 3 kids, tips, yummy recipes, giveaways & family-friendly events around Michigan. Follow to keep up with the latest from this blog.

feeds.title: The Parents with Style Blog
feeds.description: Shanda Bauman, Professional 'National Blogger, and Lifestyle Expert,' has three very active children, from ages 15 and under. She's a busy single mama, spending most of her days as a Social Content Creation Coach in Grand Rapids, MI. At The Parents with Style blog, she shares the best products, beauty tips, DIY, and recipes to help make life more stylish on a budget. Follow to get updates.

feeds.title: Holly Marie Sosa
feeds.description: I'm Holly and before any other role in life, I am a follower of Christ. I am also a crazy chicken lady, hockey mom extraordinaire, and Hallmark movie addict. This website is my online kitchen where I share simple recipes for everyday life and real families. Here you'll find recipes that are family tested, kid approved, & that use eggs fresh from my chicken's poopers. Food is my love language. Let me love you.

feeds.title: The Neat Things In Life
feeds.description: Jammie Morey is of Native American descent, she has family from the Ojibway/Chippewa tribe in Mount Pleasant, Michigan. She home school's daughter and enjoys doing many things together as a family. She loves trying new things and has a strong passion for cooking. She is also attempting to sew and make neat jewelry. Follow to keep up with the latest from this blog.

feeds.title: This Mama's Life
feeds.description: Hello, I am Amy. Located in Michigan, I love featuring local events in Michigan and northern Ohio. We also share crafts, DIY, Recipes, everyday life and you may even find a drink recipe or two. Follow to keep up with the latest from this blog.

feeds.title: Simply Every
feeds.description: Hi and welcome to Simply + Every! My name is JeeYoung, work at home mom to three boys. Consultant, Content Creator, Chaos Coordinator. I love writing about the latest mom style trends, family travel tips, and guides, and our overall lifestyle stories to connect, entertain, encourage, and inspire those who come across my everyday posts. Subscribe and keep up with the latest from this blog.

feeds.title: Kendall Rayburn
feeds.description: Hello, there! I'm Kendall and welcome to my little space on the internet. I'm a wife, momma to two adorable boys + 6 fur babies. Follow the blog and get the latest updates on Lifestyle & Family-focused content, easy recipes, decor, family-friendly activities, plus size mom fashion, pets, family travel, DIY & so much more!

feeds.title: Dash Of Evans
feeds.description: My name is Ashleigh and I live in Grand Rapids, Michigan. As a busy mom of 4, I love to share delicious home-cooked meals, with a little help from the store. I also love to show people how to save money. My blog is a mixing bowl of ideas, hence the Dash of Evans name a dash of tips, a dash of food a dash of the Evans family!

feeds.title: You Brew My Tea
feeds.description: Welcome to You Brew My Tea! Katie is our team leader, an author, homeschooling mother, plus size wannabe fashionista, and woman on a mission to change her life for the better she has a voice in many areas that are sure to resonate with you. A weblog about health and fitness, Weight Watchers recipes, homeschooling, some fun DIY and crafts, parenting, marriage, and of course travel. We often touch on tough subjects like depression, mental health, marital issues, adoption, and even obesity and society reactions. Follow to get updates.

feeds.title: Four Plus an Angel
feeds.description: Jessica Watson is a mom to five, four in her arms and one in her heart. After the loss of her infant daughter in 2007, Jessica left the corporate world behind and discovered her writing roots again. She is author of the children's book 'Soon' chronicling life after loss with kids, autism, and a teeny tiny bit of sanity. Life after loss with two triplets, a rainbow baby and a teenager with autism

feeds.title: Don't Dress Like A Mom
feeds.description: Welcome to Don't Dress Like a Mom! My name is Kari and I am a mom of two kids. I'm here to help you create looks for any occasion and to offer style advice. I want to manifest your fashion dreams (i.e. build a closet you LOVE). Through my posts, I hope you find inspiration, pieces to add to your wardrobe, and unique details to help make every day a best dressed day. Follow to keep up with the latest from this blog.

feeds.title: Mom Among Chaos
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Crystal. Mom Among Chaos is a lifestyle blog about being a mom in Michigan. I promote events, products, books, movies, travel, and more. Our target area is Metro Detroit women with children. Follow to keep up with the latest from this blog.

feeds.title: The TV Mommy
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Sarah Jaeger. A Reporter, Wife, Mother, Dog Mom, Blogger, Detroit Sports Fan, Bowler, & Shoe Addict. I'm a stay-at-home mom, cherishing every moment with my little ones and that's the beauty of a journey. Follow to get updates.

feeds.title: FREE IS MY LIFE
feeds.description: Creator of FREE IS MY LIFE, Jackie Harper, steps in to show her readers that there is a way to get great free stuff without putting in too much work. FREE IS MY LIFE is the place that helps readers to spend their money wisely by giving them tips on freebies, deals, and discounts. Follow to keep up with the latest tips and ideas from this blog.

feeds.title: Coupon Savvy Sarah
feeds.description: Sarah Muennix, a fiercely loyal wife and mother of thorns, a blogger, product & brand ambassador. Follow her blog to receive the latest articles.

feeds.title: Shannon Lazovski
feeds.description: Shannon Lazovski is one of Detroit's original fashion/beauty bloggers. After becoming a mom to Livia and Mikhail, she quickly found her digital audience by starting a blog as a hobby that allowed her to share her beauty tips, product favs, and fashion advice. Shannon's mission has always been to reach out to moms with her unique style and positive outlook on motherhood. Follow to get the latest updates.

feeds.title: Good Life
feeds.description: Hello, my name is Jill! I am a mom of two children. I started this blog as a creative outlet, to inspire myself and now I continue to do it to inspire other women. The basis of this blog is simple: it's a journey to find your/our personal style together in order to make getting dressed each morning easy and fun while not breaking the budget in the process. Follow and keep up with my latest posts.

feeds.title: Living to the Fullest
feeds.description: Hey there! I'm Shawn Ann, and I'm the owner here. I am a born-and-raised Michigander! I am a licensed cosmetologist in the state of Michigan. I've been married and have two hurricane boys. We are a virtual hub for all things mom, covering topics like Mom Tech, Gardening, Crafts, Travel Adventures, and more! Follow to keep up with our blog.

feeds.title: What's Baking, Babycakes?
feeds.description: Hi, I am Jennifer, wife, mom, blogger, baker, and the creator of What Baking, Babycakes? Here you will find it easy to make desserts, frozen treats, healthy salads, and hearty casseroles. I love blogging about family, fashion, jewelry, health, beauty, home,garden topics and spending time with my family and two Papillions! Follow to get updates.

feeds.title: Still Picking up the Pennies
feeds.description: Gwen Apger, raising a Happy, Healthy Family on Pennies and taking care of family, DH, and her two sons. Follow her blog and get ideas and tips on how to spend money and learn how to stay frugal.

feeds.title: Mother's Kitchen
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Cynthia. I love cooking and the lost domestic arts like home canning and sewing. Follow to keep up with the latest recipes of mom's kitchen from this blog.

feeds.title: XO, Angela Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Angela. I'm a lucky wife, boy mom, full-time Google account manager and lifestyle blogger. Lover of coffee, traveling, and shopping. This blog is about the working mom lifestyle, travel, and parenting. Follow to keep up with the latest from this blog.
